verdict.rationale: Stripe documents creating FinancialAccount objects through its integration guide and API, so programmatic account creation is real. The evidence does not show that these are insured deposit accounts, that the path from application to active account is fully automated, or that a sandbox mirrors the flow. missing for 10: evidence of deposit insurance, end-to-end programmatic application/approval-to-active flow, sandbox/test-mode parity for account provisioning, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a real, insured deposit account through the API — application to active account fully programmatic, with sandbox parity so the flow is tested before launch

citations.quote: Create financial accounts that can hold funds (money_manager configuration)
Stripe Treasury for Platforms provides users with a container for money called a FinancialAccount that is separate from their Payments balance.
You can use Treasury for platforms to enable your connected accounts to hold funds, pay bills, and manage their cash flow.
